sentences.text: In this Petition, filed as Public Interest Litigation, the Petitioner inter alia seeks a direction to the Respondents for strict implementation of ban on gutkha and pan masala and other chewable tobacco products which are banned by the State of Maharashtra.

2. The learned Addl. Govt. Pleader, on instructions, submits that the State Government, in exercise of powers under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Rules and Regulations made therein, has issued a Notification on 16 July 2025 banning the usage of gutkha and pan masala.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
In this Petition, filed as Public Interest Litigation, the Petitioner inter alia seeks a direction to the Respondents for strict implementation of ban on gutkha and pan masala and other chewable tobacco products which are banned by the State of Maharashtra.
2. The learned Addl. Govt. Pleader, on instructions, submits that the State Government, in exercise of powers under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Rules and Regulations made therein, has issued a Notification on 16 July 2025 banning the usage of gutkha and pan masala.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of aforesaid submission, the Respondents are directed to implement the provisions of the aforesaid Notification strictly.
4. Accordingly, the Public Interest Litigation is disposed of.
